profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a publicly traded software company, founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA, that operates the Slack messaging platform among other products. Its most recent annual filing, a 10-K covering the period ending January 31, 2026, reported revenue of $41,525,000,000. The company trades on the stock exchange under the ticker CRM and holds SEC CIK number 0001108524.

On the AI side, Salesforce offers several products across its platforms. Slack AI is embedded directly in the Slack messaging environment and the company describes it as providing channel and thread summaries, daily recaps, AI-powered search, meeting note-taking, workflow automation, and inline message translation. A feature called Slackbot is presented as a personal AI agent that the company says understands a user's tone and workspace context to help with meeting preparation, report analysis, and project briefs. The company states that customer data is not used to train the underlying large language models, and that those models are hosted within Slack's own AWS virtual private cloud. Slack also serves as the conversational interface for Agentforce, Salesforce's broader CRM-embedded AI and agent platform, which is tracked separately alongside Tableau AI, a business intelligence product incorporating Einstein AI for natural language queries and CRM data integration.

The held facts show six Model Context Protocol servers registered in connection with Salesforce, covering functions such as comprehensive Salesforce administration, SOQL query execution against Salesforce orgs, and Salesforce DevOps pipeline management. No litigation is recorded in the held facts for this company.
